description: Renames a Contacts column for the whole business, as the pencil at the top of the column does: column is an own field's key, or a built-in column, and title is the new wording (blank restores the built-in name). The values, filters and saved views under it stay as they are. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; saving the same title twice changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: rename_contact_column
title: Rename a Contacts column
